tier: Managed GenAI Services (Sherlock), Pay Per Use

free_tier.stated: unverified: no free token allowance for Sherlock is published on the pricing page, which lists per-1M-token rates only. CloudFerro advertises a separate EUR 250 free cloud-credit trial valid for 6 months, applied to standard Pay-Per-Use pricing; whether Sherlock token usage is eligible is unverified: behind a sign-up.
free_tier.notes: The free-trial page offers EUR 250 in credits valid for 6 months, subject to an application; Sherlock's own page states 'no minimum commitment' and per-token billing, with no always-free token grant.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is tokens sent to an API, not stored objects; Sherlock keeps 'zero logs · zero storage · no model training on prompts'

retention.stated: Zero logs and zero storage: prompts and outputs are not stored. No retention period applies to request bytes.

egress.terms: The Sherlock product page publishes no separate egress price; responses are returned over the API from the WAW3-2 region in Poland. CloudFerro's general cloud price list charges EUR 0.0064 per GB for internet transmission out, but that row is for cloud resources, not token responses, so whether it applies to Sherlock is unverified.

interface_detail: OpenAI-compatible REST API (chat, completions, embeddings) at https://api-sherlock.cloudferro.com/openai/v1 plus a web Playground and assistants; a Sherlock API key is created in the console after login.
tooling: the openai Python and JS SDKs with base_url swapped, LangChain and LlamaIndex via the OpenAI-compatible provider, CloudFerro Jupyter Notebooks, Managed Airflow and Managed Kubernetes; models.dev lists 5 models under id cloudferro-sherlock with package @ai-sdk/openai-compatible.
chaining: Sherlock completions and embeddings combine with CloudFerro Object Storage and Functions for RAG over document and Earth-observation corpora, all inside the EU WAW3-2 region.

limits.value: Per-token billing: the Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct row is EUR 0.35 per 1M input tokens and EUR 0.65 per 1M output tokens; nine models are listed from EUR 0.10 to EUR 0.30 input and EUR 0.15 to EUR 4.00 output per 1M tokens; no free token allowance or minimum commitment is stated
Code-based access requires an account in My Portal, a Sherlock project, and an API key created in the Sherlock console; the free-trial credits require creating an account and applying

limits_note: Per-token pricing with monthly invoicing and spend alerts; the product page states a 99.9% uptime SLA. The EUR 250 free-trial credit is valid for 6 months and is described as 'considered per applicant and revocable' on the trial page; the identity fields of the My Portal registration form were not readable.
binding_note: Every request spends tokens at the published per-1M-token rates and there is no always-free token allowance, so the token meter is what runs out first for a caller with no trial credit.

identity_cost.detail: The product page links a 'Create an account' button at https://portal.cloudferro.com/register/ and API access requires an account, a Sherlock project and an API key created in the console. The registration form is a JavaScript application whose fields are not present in the fetched HTML, so the exact fields asked are unverified: behind a sign-up; the free-trial page says to 'Create an account and apply for 250€ free credits'. Whether a card is required is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: The vendor states zero logs, zero storage and no model training on prompts, processing confined to the WAW3-2 region in Poland, and a 99.9% uptime SLA. No throttle or outage was observed; no request was made.
confidence_note: Rates and the zero-storage policy are quoted from CloudFerro's own pricing and Sherlock product pages read 2026-11-24; the API/account gate is quoted from the Sherlock user guide read the same day. models.dev is a third-party catalogue used only to corroborate the API base and model count. No live request was measured.
